> The purpose is not certainty. It is knowing how wrong the map can be while entry is still the right call.
 Perfect information about a market arrives after the market has moved. Naming the blocking unknowns and the size of the bet they justify turns an unresolvable argument about confidence into a resolvable one about exposure.
